CSCA Test Centres & Home-Based Exam Options

Check CSCA home-based and test-centre options on the official portal. Confirm your sitting, location and technical requirements before booking travel.

Check csca.cn for the exam modes and authorised locations available for your sitting. Official guidance describes home-based online, computer-based and paper-based formats. Availability is not guaranteed in every country or for every sitting.

How to confirm your mode

Open the official sitting notice and registration options. Check your booking confirmation and admission ticket. Do not assume that an HSK centre, embassy or university is also an authorised CSCA venue.

We do not maintain a verified worldwide centre list. A Shanghai government guide records the first on-site CSCA centres opening in Vietnam and Thailand in December 2025; that is historical context, not a current directory or guarantee of availability.

Home-based preparation

Use the current candidate requirements for devices, cameras, software, network and room setup. Complete the official technical checks. A practice website running on your computer does not demonstrate that the official exam environment will work.

Centre-based preparation

Confirm the official address, arrival time, accepted ID and permitted items before booking travel. If attending a centre outside your country, check applicable entry requirements with the responsible authorities. The exam booking does not grant permission to enter another country.

Time zones

The official schedule uses Beijing time. Convert it to your location for the actual exam date, including daylight-saving changes where relevant. Check both the date and time against the admission ticket.

If information conflicts

Follow the latest official notice for your sitting and ask official support to clarify unresolved issues. Scholarship offices and study groups may help you find information, but do not replace the exam organiser’s booking and candidate instructions.

See the registration guide, exam calendar and exam-day checklist.

Official sources

CSCA portal — current syllabus, sitting notices, candidate instructions and results.

Shanghai government CSCA guide — subjects, format and application context.

This independent preparation guide does not replace the current exam instructions or the receiving university’s admission notice.
